report: Independently reassessed the complete claim and both associated TODO entries: the implementation region in sage_meta::todo and test sage_meta::todo::sage_entities_have_direct_links (test:spec_plan). The complete supplied spec_plan.rs explicitly declares assertion-free placeholders pending implementation-plan stages; this test has no assertions and supplies no behavioral proof. Its TODO covers all entity kinds (crates, modules, types, classes, contexts, methods/queries, fields and variants), immediate selection in rendered context without prior search/session, owner-qualified identity and same-name disambiguation, chapter-move stability, references from Markdown and Sage, and dangling-reference errors. The requirement to avoid invented specification rules preserves the distinction between entity identity and anchored claims and does not require extra named prose. Syntax and URL spelling remain design choices, not missing predetermined spellings. Captured the referenced explorer_navigation claim: chapter URL selection, restoration, back/forward agreement and preservation of book context are deferred along with entity-link/browser integration; the supplied full file also explicitly identifies the synchronized_explorer_urls pending work. Prerequisites are an entity/member identity resolver, reference validation, rendered selection URLs and browser-history integration, followed by focused assertions for these cases. The current explicit implementation/test TODO rationale adequately retains this work without claiming implementation or test adequacy for completed behavior; no edits requested. Baseline: personally verified exact byte equality of current spec_plan.rs against BOTH historical implementation_sources and test_sources snapshots, then assessed current claim/metadata and TODO rationale rather than inheriting approval. Source inspection is the evidence for accepting the deferral. Executed review start, review read, byte comparison, and review record; no behavior tests or build were run by this reviewer. Coordinator reports 321 functional sage-meta tests and root build passed; those are separate execution reports and do not establish this deferred behavior.
